evidence_pattern: the year cannot be read anywhere and must be approximated
designer_notes: THE CHART THE `20999999` DEFECT NEEDED. Two E4 runs put 99 in the YEAR slot because decision_rule[5] orders an approximation and no field could record that one had been made; the value space now can, and nothing tested it. Note which flags are true: the year was approximated, the month and day are simply not recorded — a distinction one boolean could not make, and the reason there are three. The hard anchor is in a claims feed, which is a source class a run reading only clinical note types never opens.
designed_from: contract_clause: decision_rule[5] (the year must be approximated)

STORE.390.date_of_initial_diagnosis.why: No document states a diagnosis date. The establishing-care note of 2019-06-04 says the cancer was treated 'roughly four years ago' at an outside hospital, and the pharmacy feed carries an adjuvant capecitabine course beginning 2015-08-17 — which cannot establish a diagnosis but does bound the year. decision_rule[5]: the year is APPROXIMATED to 2015 and month and day are then unknown, so 20159999 with year_imputed true.

STORE.400_522_523.site_histology_behavio.why: No pathology in the record; histology must NOT be inferred from imaging.

expect.requires: approximating a year from a non-clinical source class
